dictionary.title: Control panel
dictionary.empty_hint: Try another name or change the category and state.
dictionary.settings_subtitle: Real-time management of visual modules on the kiosk display (:80) and neural backend runtime.
dictionary.card_frontend_sub: Customize visual components and interface areas in real time.
dictionary.opt_assistant_name_desc: Show or hide the dynamic assistant title in the top-left corner.
dictionary.opt_clock_desc: Show or hide the digital clock in the top-right corner of the display.
dictionary.opt_date_desc: Show or hide the current date below the clock.
dictionary.opt_thinking_desc: Show or hide the Mind box displaying the cognitive model and latent thoughts.
dictionary.opt_dock_desc: Show or hide the bottom dock with chat input and send button.
dictionary.opt_mic_desc: Show or hide the microphone button and audio wave listener.
dictionary.opt_telemetry_chips_desc: Show or hide bus latency and status indicator pills at the top.
dictionary.opt_presence_desc: Show or hide the vision status and human proximity indicator.
dictionary.opt_holo_avatar_desc: Enable or disable 3D holographic sphere rendering on the display.
dictionary.opt_desk_widgets_desc: Show or hide the central interactive widget canvas (Desk).
dictionary.opt_sound_effects_desc: Enable or disable acoustic feedback and interaction sounds.
dictionary.card_backend_sub: Configure LLM runtime, Ollama server endpoint, and mesh compute resources.
dictionary.opt_auto_shutdown_local_desc: When a remote Ollama server is active, stop local instance to free host RAM.
dictionary.opt_mesh_broadcast_desc: Share presence and capabilities of this server across the local network.
dictionary.opt_mesh_state_sync_desc: Synchronize shared memory and configs in real time across mesh peers.
dictionary.opt_process_watchdog_desc: Automatically restart failing cognitive engines or background processes.
dictionary.opt_verbose_telemetry_desc: Log detailed analytical reasoning steps to the sensory bus.
